examples.japanese: {月給|げっきゅう}は{毎月|まいつき}{25日|にじゅうごにち}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる。
examples.english: My monthly salary is deposited on the 25th of every month.

examples.japanese: {月給|げっきゅう}{制|せい}の{仕事|しごと}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I am looking for a job with a monthly salary.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{月給|げっきゅう}は{30万円|さんじゅうまんえん}だ。

notes:
{月給|げっきゅう} refers to a fixed monthly salary, typical for full-time employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月給|げっきゅう}をもらう (to receive monthly salary)
- {月給|げっきゅう}{制|せい} (monthly salary system)
- {額面|がくめん}{月給|げっきゅう} (gross monthly salary)
- {手取|てど}り{月給|げっきゅう} (take-home monthly salary)

CONTRAST:
- {月給|げっきゅう}: Fixed monthly salary (typical for {正社員|せいしゃいん})
- {時給|じきゅう}: Hourly wage (typical for part-time)
- {日給|にっきゅう}: Daily wage
- {年俸|ねんぽう}: Annual salary

NOTE:
{月給|げっきゅう} usually includes {基本給|きほんきゅう} (base pay) and various {手当|てあて} (allowances).
